changeSet.author: nyi
changeSet.comment: Align the persisted TripStatus value with spec 6.1. The enum constant was renamed OPEN -> OPEN_FOR_SALE; stored rows keep the old literal until this migration rewrites them, otherwise TripStatus.valueOf() fails on read.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE trips SET status = 'OPEN_FOR_SALE' WHERE status = 'OPEN';
changeSet.rollback: UPDATE trips SET status = 'OPEN' WHERE status = 'OPEN_FOR_SALE';

changeSet.author: nyi
changeSet.comment: Align the persisted BookingStatus value with spec 6.2. The enum constant was renamed PAID -> CONFIRMED. seat_assignments.status is a separate vocabulary and is intentionally left alone.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE bookings SET status = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE status = 'PAID';
changeSet.rollback: UPDATE bookings SET status = 'PAID' WHERE status = 'CONFIRMED';
